title: 美国失业救济申请降至196,000 创7月以来新低
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Kevin Hort said yesterday we can pretty much ignore the labor market for right now and that's what jobless claims are telling us. 196,000 that is close to the all-time low again. That's down
segments.zh: Kevin Hort昨天说目前劳动力市场基本可以忽略，失业金申请数据也印证了这点。19.6万，接近历史最低，比前一周的20.6万有所下降，所以没什么变化。

segments.en: from 206,000 the week before, so nothing happening there. Now the Philadelphia Fed is also out with its index and the number that we care about, I mean the headline number is 37-8 comes down from 47-4,
segments.zh: 费城联储也公布了指数，我们关注的整体数字是37.8，从47.4降下来，所以与Worse关于扩张的说法不符，但人们会关注支付价格和接收价格，接收价格升至31.3，之前是17.7，这类似于PPI数据。

segments.en: so it doesn't match what Worse was saying about expansion but its prices paid and prices received that people are going to be watching and prices received up to 31.3 versus 17.7 those would be like
segments.zh: 支付价格指数从40.9升至48.6，所以通胀是费城联储指数中的问题，就业在国内似乎不是问题。

segments.en: PPI numbers and then the prices paid index goes up to 48.6 from 40.9 so inflation is the problem
segments.zh: 住房开工数下降2.6%，较上月的9%降幅有所收窄，但真正的问题是当前住宅建设不足，利率过高，不过随着市场变动，按揭利率可能略有下降。

segments.en: in the Philadelphia Fed index jobs don't seem to be the problem in the country. We also have housing starts out down 2.6% we've fallen that is down from a drop of 9% the prior month but the real
segments.zh: 收益率曲线趋平，10年期国债收益率下降。

segments.en: issue is that we're not building enough houses at this point and the interest rates are too high but maybe we'll see the mortgage rates come down a little bit now that we're seeing the market move
segments.zh: 问题在于我们目前没有建造足够的房屋，而且利率过高，但也许随着市场变动，按揭利率会有所下降

segments.en: and the yield curve flatten with the 10-year note coming down.
segments.zh: 收益率曲线趋平，10年期国债收益率下行。
